title: The taxi terminal is “down”
scenario: At an airport taxi rank, the driver says the card terminal is offline and points to a QR code taped to the dashboard for cashless payment. The fare on the meter looks normal.

answers.A: Use the taxi company’s official payment method, ask for another licensed taxi, or pay through a verified terminal—not the loose QR code.
answers.B: Ask the airport taxi marshal or dispatch desk whether that QR payment method is approved.
answers.C: Scan the QR and pay a small amount first to see whether the driver confirms receipt.

explanation: A correct fare does not authenticate a payment destination. Loose QR codes can redirect money or collect card details.
proTip: Verify the destination before you verify the amount.
